basic_details.job_title: National Book Trust Typesetter Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: National Book Trust has notified 2 Typesetter vacancies on a contract basis through a manpower agency initially for three months which can be extended. Candidates applying for the post must possess Higher Secondary or above, a Certificate course in Graphic Software, and a minimum 2 years working experience in InDesign and other Graphic software and Typesetting/Designing, along with an age below 40 yrs. how_to_apply: Interested candidates who fulfill the minimum eligibility criteria may apply online through the National Book Trust, India website at www.nbtindia.gov.in within 15 days from the date of publication of the advertisement on the Trust's website (about 29 October 2026).
important_instructions: National Book Trust, India reserves the right not to fill up the posts as advertised, if circumstances so warrant.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 35,000/- per month. The appointment is purely on a contract basis through a manpower agency initially for three months, which can be extended as per the requirement of the Trust. The notification does not mention any allowances.

content_sections.heading: National Book Trust Typesetter Job Description
content_sections.text: Providing in-house typesetting support for the publication activities of NBT India. Selected Candidates will be required to undertake typesetting, page layout, Incorporation of corrections, preparation of print-ready files/PDFs and other related production work.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available for National Book Trust Typesetter recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies in total, comprising 1 post for English and 1 post for Hindi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for National Book Trust Typesetter?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting online applications is within 15 days from the date of publication of the advertisement on the Trust's website (about 29 October 2026).

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for National Book Trust Typesetter?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess Higher Secondary or above along with a Certificate course in Graphic Software.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for National Book Trust Typesetter?
faq.answer: The age limit for applicants is below 40 yrs.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for National Book Trust Typesetter?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 35,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What experience is required for National Book Trust Typesetter?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a minimum of 2 years working experience in InDesign and other Graphic software and Typesetting/Designing, proficiency in InDesign, Photoshop and Illustrator, and typing knowledge in English or Hindi.

faq.question: Q7. Is the National Book Trust Typesetter post permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The post is purely on a contract basis through a manpower agency initially for three months, which can be extended as per requirement of the Trust.

faq.question: Q8. How can candidates apply for National Book Trust Typesetter?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official National Book Trust website at www.nbtindia.gov.in along with the submission of their sample works.
